# anthropic_service_account (Data Source)

Reads a single Anthropic service account by ID (`GET /v1/organizations/service_accounts/{id}`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique tagged identifier of the service account (`svac_...`).

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the service account was archived, or `null` if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the service account was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the service account, or `null`.
- `name` (String) Slug name of the service account.
- `organization_role` (String) Organization-level role assigned to the service account.
- `type` (String) Object type (`service_account`).
